summary: A Sega Mega Drive / Genesis music tracker that emulates the YM2612 FM chip and the SN76489 PSG, with a Deflemask- and Furnace-style pattern editor played from the FM-1.
features: 6 four-operator FM channels, FM3 extended mode, DAC samples on FM6
3 PSG tone channels plus noise; model 1 or 2 filter, NTSC or PAL
Up to 256 patterns per channel, 256 orders, Deflemask Genesis effects
128 FM and 32 PSG presets, 48-sample drum kit, user slots
256 song slots; VGM export; songs moved over USB MIDI SysEx
Browser editor imports VGMs; can't read other firmwares' data
